title: Tuesday is a good day to do the hardest task first
dek: Monday is for catching up, which makes Tuesday morning a good time to start the work you have been putting off.
keywords: how to stop procrastinating at work
body: Monday usually goes to catching up. There are emails from the weekend, meetings to plan the week and a list of small things that need an answer. By the end of it, a lot of people feel busy without having started anything important.

Tuesday often feels different. The inbox is calmer, the week has a shape, and there is still plenty of time before Friday. That makes Tuesday morning a good time to take on the one task you have been avoiding.

It helps to start it before opening email. Give it an hour with notifications off and the door closed if you can. You do not need to finish it. The goal is real progress while your energy is still fresh.
When the hard thing gets attention early, the rest of the day tends to feel lighter. It is no longer sitting over your shoulder, and the smaller tasks go faster when there is nothing left to dread.
This morning, pick the one task you have been putting off, and give it your first hour before anything else.
